status: Declared after engineering simulation/fit setup and direct injected-sign test, before scientific recovered brightness contrasts or classifier probabilities were inspected.

selection.quality: ERRFLAG_FIT=0, x1 in[-3,3], c in[-.3,.3], x1ERR in(0,1), cERR in(0,1.5), PKMJDERR in(0,2), FITPROB>.001, 0.05<=zHD<=1.2; finite positive parameter uncertainties and positive-definite supplied 3x3 light-curve covariance
selection.primary_classifier: Reconstructed SNNV19 pIa>.5, matching the documented P23 population-fitting selection threshold. This is not the complete DES BEAMS analysis.
sensitivities: Remove generated screens with negative F99 extinction on rest3500–8000A

correction.native: Attempt released BBC4D options, then separately labeled native1D option if sparse independent training causes failed support. Retain native output failures.
correction.independent_predictive_comparison: Fit a weighted training-only linear brightness model with width, colour and mass step against known simulated distance. Learn its residual with40-nearest-neighbour regression in coordinates z/.1,x1,c/.1,continuous mass. Prediction supported only if the40th neighbour is within scaled distance3. No true age/dust in prediction.
correction.counterfactual_training: Apply both nominal and independently age-injected training to the same age-injected evaluation sample. Nominal evaluation provides null closure.
correction.rationale: A simple training-only reference tests absorbed/remainder terms and interpolation support while native production4D is separately gated; it cannot replace a fully regenerated survey likelihood.

uncertainty: 500 block bootstrap replicates, seed2026092702; resample training and evaluation LIBID blocks independently, refit nuisance coefficients and correction means, retain off-diagonal redshift-bin covariance. Shared evaluation seeds are verified by occurrence identity before covariance coupling, not assumed from CID.
no_cosmological_claim: The age population and physical screens are declared simulation hypotheses. Their residual response and precision do not establish the real correction or a new cosmology.
